figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Structures and proposed biosynthetic pathway for SBNs. (A) The basic skeletons of three different types of SBNs. (B) Representative
structures of each type of SBNs. (C) Proposed biosynthetic pathway for PC13 (7) by Bode et al.,[14] including Krohn’s hypothetic route to PCP1 (3).[4a]

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Biosynthesis of palmarumycins. (A) BGC for DHN. Chr.:
Chromosome. (B) BGC for palmarumycin (pal). TF: Transcription
factor; SDR: Short chain dehydrogenase/reductase; MFS: Major
Facilitator Superfamily. (C) Log2(fold change) of the related genes
between palmarumycin-producing and non-producing conditions.
(D) HPLC profiles (left, λ=226 nm) and colony morphologies (right,
PDA, 30 days) of the gene-disrupted mutants and WT (wild type).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. HPLC analysis (λ=226 nm) of A. oryzae transformants harboring different heterologous genes and substrate feeding experiments.
(A) Expressing DHN-cassette and pal genes in A. oryzae. DHN-cassette=bdpks+bdr+scd. *-unrelated peak. (B) Feeding DHN (1) to various AO-
transformants for 1 day. #note: the 3-days profile was shown for clarity. For full time-course profiles, see Figure S11–S14. (C) Structures of the
metabolites.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. In vitro reactions of PalA. (A) Reactions with the yeast
microsomal fraction of PalA (LC–MS, λ=226 nm) for 12 h (trace i–iv)
or 24 h (trace v–viii). *-unrelated peak. Note: NADPH was added to
each reaction mixture, containing the endogenous cytochrome P450
oxidoreductase (CPR). (B) Chemical synthesis of the phenolic dinaph-
thalene ether (19). TsOH: p-toluenesulfonic acid; PDC: pyridinium
dichromate; TMSI: trimethylsilyl iodide.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Docking and site-directed mutation of PalA. (A) Docking pose
of 19 with PalA. The predicted amino acid residues interacting with
substrates shown in line format, while Heme (light-brown) and
substrate (pink) are shown in stick format. (B) HPLC analysis of the
enzymatic assay of 1 with the selected mutants of PalA. Note: Only the
significant results shown. *-unrelated peak.

figure_candidates.label: Scheme 1
figure_candidates.caption: Scheme 1. The proposed mechanism for the formation of PC2 (4) catalyzed by PalA.
